requirements.description: User explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct gross surface threshold.
User wants the unit located near parks. Per the 'near' proximity rule, the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of green (74.26), rounded to 74.
User requires energy class D or better, which covers classes A1 through D. Area, capacity, location (near parks) and use-authorization requirements are outside the energy scope and are not included.
